text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: What does being an "adult" even mean?

Listening closely to the story for now,
it seems the incident happened yesterday.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Man, an orca baby?! I can't wait to see it!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Oh, so this is the ticket counter!
Um, excuse me—

text_block_list.name: Receptionist
text_block_list.text: All right, two elementary school tickets, please?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: What d'ya mean, elementary schooler?!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Well, okay, I admit I might be a bit petite!
Just a bit! But still!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Just look at this overflowing big sis spirit!
No matter how you look at it, I'm already a fine Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
...Well, still!
We ain't little kids anymore, ya know.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
I'll swallow the fact that you mistook me for someone else for now.
Just shut up and let's work on a countermeasure, I say—

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
So that's why I came to ask the grown-up
closest to me!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Her behavior, her way of speaking, or even her looks—anything works!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"You know any good, grown-up vibes
that'll level up our adult game?"

It was quite a difficult question, but
what instantly came to mind was—
choice_data_list: She knows how to manage herself!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Hoo, self-management! So it means looking after yourself
without burdening anyone else.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Hm, but doesn't that mean—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Either way, let's give it a shot!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
First off, wake up on your own in the morning!
Mornin' to ya!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Moderate exercise for good health!
It's pretty much like training, huh.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
An' next, makin' my own meal!
Eatin' a balanced meal with no picky stuff.
Time to dig in!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Wait, you're just acting like you always do!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
So what, you tellin' me we've been
adults this whole damn time?!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Yeah.
I was worrying too much, unlike myself.

In any case, whether they were satisfied or not,
the two left the room with
somewhat bright expressions.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Saving money~? I do that all the time though...
Does that really make someone an adult?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
...Well, fine.
If you say so, it's worth a shot.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
So basically, I just gotta boost my savings, right?!
I'm gonna rake in more dough than ever!
A few days later—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Step right up, step right up, welcome, welcome~!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"Get your takoyaki! Right now, just 250 yen a box!
Or get two boxes for 400 yen~!"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Ah! That's the one people say is delicious!
Excuse me, two of these, please!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: There are four over here... wait, six!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for your business~!
Man, I've got a feeling we'll sell out in no time!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Ain't these some great sales for a single day!
Look at us, we're proper adults now, yeah?!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Gwahaha!
This is the kitchen of Tracen Academy!

—Afterwards, Air Groove caught wind of the commotion
and gave me an earful... but that's a story for another time.
